Extensive experience in the completion of complex and detailed proposals and related materials.

Seven to ten years' successful professional development and/or fundraising-related experience, preferably in higher education at a R01 university, OR, any equivalent combinations of education and/or experience from which comparable knowledge, skill and abilities have been achieved.

Under the general direction of the Associate Vice Chancellor, Strategic Philanthropy, and located in University Advancement’s Central unit, the Executive Director of Corporate and Foundation Relations (ED) provides leadership and direction for a comprehensive foundation and corporate relations strategy for UC Irvine. Working closely with academic, administrative and development leaders, the ED will develop proactive strategies to increase philanthropic and corporate support for research, university priorities and interdisciplinary initiatives.

Leads and manages the Corporate and Foundation Relations (CFR) team whose goal is to enhance and strengthen existing University relationships with corporations, corporate foundations, associations like the American Cancer Society, and private foundations, as well as increase funding to the university from these organizations. Develops strategies for identifying and building relationships with new philanthropists and their organizations, helps develop strategies for major gifts and grants with both existing funders and aspirational foundations, and monitors stewardship plans for strategic corporate and foundation donors. In collaboration with the Associate Vice Chancellor for Strategic Philanthropy, may be consulted by the Office of Research about contemplated Organized Research Units (ORUs) and other emerging research initiatives to provide insight on corporate and foundation funding opportunities, sponsor alignment, funding competitiveness, and strategies to enhance external support.

Demonstrated ability to secure seven-figure gifts from foundations, associations and/or corporate foundations and record of proactive outreach to organizations resulting in new relationships and/or funding. Expected to raise an initial annual goal of $4+ million in funds worked on directly and assist in team goal of $20M+, with these goals to increase year over year.
Highly organized and able to handle multiple projects.
May work long hours to meet fundraising commitments
Local, regional, and national travel
Must maintain a hybrid presence on campus, with a minimum of two days per week on campus and more as needed.
Another Source is leading this search. For more information or to apply, please visit this link:
https://careers-anothersource.icims.com/jobs/102586/executive-director-of-corporate-and-foundation-relations---uc-irvine/job
Expert working knowledge of all aspects of fundraising, donor relations, and public relations concepts, principles, procedures, and techniques.
Demonstrated ability to read academic and scientific text and convey this information effectively to different audiences. Comfort in speaking effectively in front of large audiences.
Expert knowledge of applicable laws, rules, regulations, policies, etc.

Expert knowledge of all aspects of the location, including current issues of concern for both the campus and / or throughout higher education / healthcare, generally. Expert knowledge of the location, including its vision, mission, goals, objectives, achievements and infrastructure.

Expert written and interpersonal communication skills, including political acumen, to establish and maintain good working relationships throughout the organization and with outside constituencies. Expert skills in making persuasive and compelling presentations of goals and objectives for a location in order to secure gifts.

Expert organizational, analytical and critical thinking skills. Expert project / program management skills, including skills in setting and meeting program / project goals and objectives within budget and time constraints.
Expert level skills in maintaining confidentiality.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Salesforce or a comparable donor/prospect database system.
Clarity of focus while juggling complex projects and/or deadlines. Ability to meet demanding work schedule expectations
